verdict.rationale: Convex's own materials list text search as a built-in feature: it appears in the Free/Starter pricing tier, llms.txt says Convex 'includes … vector search, text search', and the homepage pitches search as part of the platform with 'zero glue'. That means no external search service is needed. The evidence is only feature-list mentions, though, not a dedicated full-text search doc. The vector-search docs cover semantic similarity, which is a different capability. Missing for 10: dedicated full-text search documentation (search index definition, query syntax, relevance ranking, filtering), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
